name: Unwrap
description: Search and analyze your customer feedback with Unwrap. Pull in customer feedback themes and anecdotes, filter by metadata and analyze trends with issues over time. Use your customers feedback to build data backed roadmaps, PRD's, and more!

_published_faq.name: How do I add Unwrap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Unwrap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://nlp.api.production.unwrap.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Unwrap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unwrap lists 17 MCP tools, including list_views, get_started, list_feedback_integrations, search_segments, list_segment_field_values, discover_filter_schema, search_groups, search_actionable_groups, plot_chart, sample_feedback_entries, analyze_entry_text, and classify_feedback_entries.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Unwrap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Unwrap in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Unwrap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Unwrap is developed by Unwrap AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
